name: Visa-free entry with Travel Authorization
summary: No visa for anyone. You must complete an online Travel Authorization before travel, then get a Visitor's Permit on arrival.

savings.note: At least USD 150 per day of the stay

other: Return or onward ticket
Confirmed accommodation
Passport valid for the whole stay
TA fee and validity not confirmed

stay.note: Up to 12 months total with extensions

name: Visitor's Permit and extensions
summary: Free for the first 3 months. Extend in 3-month blocks up to 12 months total.

other: Not already holding a residence permit
Return or onward ticket, accommodation, enough funds
Valid ETA before leaving home

steps: Apply at permits.ics.gov.sc or at Independence House, Victoria

name: Gainful Occupation Permit (GOP)
summary: Work permit for employees and the self-employed. Employees need an approval certificate first. Business starters submit a Project Memorandum to the Seychelles Investment Board.

other: Do not enter to start work before the permit is issued
Duration is chosen by the applicant, not stated on the page

name: Residence Permit (non-working)
summary: For people with a family tie to Seychelles or a special contribution to its life. Covers 5 years. No employment allowed.

other: Family or domestic connection, or special contribution
Proof of finances with banker confirmation
Bank guarantee of at least SCR 20,000
At least 5 days in Seychelles per 12 months

name: Dependents Permit
summary: Permit for family of a permit holder. Details were not opened, check the official page.

other: Requirements not confirmed

name: Student Permit
summary: Permit for studying in Seychelles. Details were not opened, check the official page.

other: Requirements not confirmed

name: Permanent Residence
summary: Holders can work without a GOP and buy property with Government sanction at 50% of the sanction fee. Years needed and fee are not stated on the page.

other: Not a prohibited immigrant
Absences under 1 year without Minister's consent
No prison sentence over 1 year
Years of residence required not stated

name: Citizenship by marriage or parental descent
summary: Marriage route needs 15 years married to a citizen plus 2 or more years of legal residence. Parental descent route has no residence rule listed. Exam in English, French or Kreol.

other: Pass the citizenship exam at 80% or more
No absence of 1 year or more without Minister's permission
No prison sentence of 1 year or more
Dual citizenship not addressed on the page

citizenship.note: Surviving spouse and descent routes also exist.
